proof_attempt_summary: D0 discharged the pilot-product bottleneck and derived matched log-free homogeneous-family and whole-class honest interval rates min{1,(n delta^2)^(-2/7)}, exact consistency, an original-record lower bound, and a converse-only supermodel transfer; math and decision reviews passed. The field target failed on fixed-benchmark breadth, general-functional analogues, and an explicit interval that remains full-range for n delta^2 <= 1.28e51. These are informal reviewed derivations: no F-stage Lean proof was attempted; future work would require a new anchor or substantial calibration theorem, not a same-scope retry.
tldr: For the variance of conditional mean causal effects in this outcome-only randomized-response benchmark, both the globally honest homogeneous-family and whole-class expected-length optima have the same finite-sample, log-free order \(\min\{1,(n\delta^2)^{-2/7}\}\). Explicit data-only intervals and a normalized original-record mixture converse establish the two sides uniformly for every \(n\geq2\) and \(\delta\in(0,1]\). Both criteria permit uniformly vanishing expected length along an arbitrary channel sequence exactly when \(n\delta_n^2\to\infty\). The model retains unknown rough propensity and baseline functions, every unknown homogeneous constant, and the stated pointwise \([1/4,3/4]\) envelopes. The lower bound also transfers to larger causal randomized-response models retaining the explicit witnesses; the upper bounds retain the benchmark assumptions.
gap: PCM leaves uniformly valid confidence intervals for its zero-at-null signal as a research direction, while the causal variance literature separates regular inference from boundary behavior \cite{LundborgKimShahSamworth2024,HinesDiazOrdazVansteelandt2025}. These results do not evaluate finite globally honest true-target interval length over this full composite causal null.
fill: A profiled covariance residual, an integrated pilot-product envelope, and a direct projected pair statistic provide the upper construction. Normalized original four-cell mixtures provide the all-procedure converse. A multilinear expansion handle leaves the whole-class comparison answer open.
